workflows.name: design-review
workflows.description: Brainstorm a design with superpowers, then stress-test it

steps.task: Brainstorm the requested feature and write the design doc
Critique docs/design.md bluntly; write your verdict and required changes

workflows.name: security-review
workflows.description: Threat-model a feature area with Cloudflare's security-audit skill

steps.task: Threat-model the requested feature area: who can reach this code, what they can influence, what they gain. Rank findings by exploitability and write the audit report

workflows.name: research-to-verdict
workflows.description: Research a problem, review the architecture options, then take a verdict

steps.task: Research the requested problem and write up the findings and constraints
Read docs/research.md and review the architecture options against it: trade-offs, failure modes, your recommendation
Read docs/research.md and docs/architecture-review.md and write the final verdict: which option, why, and what the other reviews got wrong
